tagline: Accredited postsecondary education provider delivering industry-relevant programs across fully online, campus-based and hybrid learning modalities
hero_kpi_rationale: Core metric for accredited higher education institutions, reflecting growth in user base and academic reach of Perdoceo

kpis.name: Total Student Enrollments
kpis.explanation: Total number of students enrolled in degree academic programs
kpis.description: Total student enrollments as of December 31, 2025

kpis.name: Online Enrollment Percentage
kpis.explanation: Percentage of students enrolled in fully online programs
kpis.description: Approximately 91% of total student enrollments are in fully-online academic programs as of December 31, 2025 and 2024
kpis.signal: Strong reliance on fully online model

kpis.name: Business Studies Enrollment Share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of students enrolled in business studies programs
kpis.description: Business Studies represents 66% of total student enrollments by core curricula as of December 31, 2025
kpis.signal: Majority of student base concentrated in business field

kpis.name: Over 30 Years Old Enrollment Share
kpis.description: Over 30 years old demographic represents 68% of total student enrollments as of December 31, 2025
kpis.signal: High concentration of non-traditional adult learners

kpis.name: Total Student Enrollments YoY Growth
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year increase in total student enrollments from 2024 to 2025
kpis.description: Total student enrollments increased from 41,380 students in 2024 to 44,400 students in 2025

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

ai_positioning.summary: Perdoceo integrates data analytics and personalized learning technologies in its academic institutions to enhance learning experiences and serve students more effectively
evidence: Data analytics and technology utilization to serve and educate students
Enhancement of overall learning and academic experiences through technology
